shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.fullbody: The whole person is visible from head to shoes, standing, with a little space above the head and below the shoes.
shared_prompts.offframe: The person they are talking to is NOT in the photo: they stand just outside the edge of the photo that is named, so no part of that person (no hand, arm, shoulder or shadow) is visible.
shared_prompts.candles: The cake has a few plain thin birthday candles with small flames; there are no number candles and no writing on the cake.

assets.item: Why is Ana excited? Because it's her birthday.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. She must be the SAME woman as in image 1: the same face, the same long dark wavy hair, the same light-olive skin and the same build. She wears her sage-green overshirt over a white top and blue jeans. Create a new photograph: in her bright living room Ana stands right behind a table with her BIRTHDAY CAKE on it, a round white cake with lit candles, and a few plain colored balloons float beside her. She is VERY EXCITED: both fists raised up beside her shoulders, her mouth wide open in a huge delighted smile, her eyes wide and bright, looking down at the cake. Her excitement and the birthday cake are both obvious at a glance. She is seen from the waist up, in the middle of the photo, with the cake in front of her.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: Luis is wearing a blue T-shirt.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. He must be the SAME man as in image 1: the same broad face with strong jaw and thick dark eyebrows, the same short dark curly hair, the same warm medium-brown skin, clean-shaven, and the same tall, strong, broad-shouldered build. Create a new photograph: Luis stands in a sunny park on a warm day and smiles; he is seen from the knees up, standing in the middle of the photo, with his arms relaxed at his sides. He is wearing a plain BRIGHT BLUE T-SHIRT with short sleeves that end above his elbows and a round neck, and nothing over it; his arms are bare below the short sleeves. He also wears light khaki trousers. The T-shirt is plain, with no print, no pocket, no buttons and no collar: it is a T-shirt, NOT a button shirt and NOT a polo shirt. The blue T-shirt is the most obvious thing he is wearing. He wears no jacket, no sweater, no hat, no scarf and no glasses.

assets.item: Diego is wet because it's raining.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Diego. He must be the SAME man as in image 1: the same face, the same dark curly hair with a little grey, the same short full beard and the same build. He wears his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph: Diego stands on a city sidewalk in HEAVY RAIN with NO umbrella, no hood and no coat. He is completely WET: his hair is soaked flat and dripping, water runs down his face, and his shirt is dark, soaked and stuck to his shoulders and arms. He holds his arms a little out from his body and looks down at his wet shirt with an unhappy face. Many raindrops are falling all around him and splashing in the puddles on the ground; the sky is grey. He is seen from the knees up in the middle of the photo. It is obvious at a glance that it is raining and that he is very wet.
